jobs.occupation: Grouplead Mechanical Engineering (m/f/d) Data Center (Leiter/in - Engineering)
jobs.description: Your vision is ambitious. Just like ours.Our people are our success. As one of us, you will contribute to engineering excellence for the high-tech markets of the future, including semiconductors, batteries, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and data centers. At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company's long history and keep on leading the way to a better worldDiscover your exciting rolesWe are currently looking for a dedicated and motivated Group Leader Mechanical Engineering (f/m/d) at our Bad Homburg site. You will join our Engineering & Design department focusing on Plant Utility & HVAC systems for Data Centers.Explore your tasks and responsibilities- Lead and develop a team of engineers within the Engineering & Design department- Plan, design, and implement building services systems (heating, ventilation/air conditioning, plumbing, sprinkler) for new construction and renovation projects- Ensure compliance with applicable German standards and regulations in building services engineering (e.g., DIN, VDI, VDE)- Coordinate and communicate with internal departments, clients, and external partners, planners, and service providers- Prepare and review technical specifications, bills of quantities, and design plans- Support tender processes, proposal evaluations, and supplier selection- Ensure quality throughout project execution up to commissioning- Assist in budget and resource planning as well as in schedule tracking- Participate in site visits, planning meetings, and coordination discussionsShow your expertises- Degree in building services engineering, HVAC engineering, mechanical engineering, or a comparable field- Solid experience in planning and executing building services systems in a industry project environment- Strong knowledge of relevant German standards, guidelines, and legal requirements for building services in industrial projects- Fluent in both German and English, spoken and written - essential- Willingness to travel- Leadership experience is a plus, but not mandatory - initiative and team spirit are key- Structured, solution-oriented approach and a high sense of responsibility- Proficiency in CAD systems, planning tools, and MS OfficeWas wir bieten- Your start at Exyte: Take part in a two-day onboarding event with new colleagues- Attractive location: Our location in Stuttgart features spacious workstations with height-adjustable desks- Buddy-System: Several weeks of close familiarisation with your colleagues in the team- Work-life balance: There is always the possibility of switching to mobile working- Catering: Free coffee specialities as well as water dispensers are accessible on every floor- Keep fit: Exyte subsidises your fitness contract through Qualitrain at over 5,000 locations in GermanyContactYou want to be part of the Exyte team? We look forward to receiving your application!For further questions and information, please do not hesitate to contact Ugur Guezel via E-Mail at ugur.guezel@exyte.netPlease note that we only consider applications submitted through our application portal. jobs.occupation: Join Native Nanny – International Childcare Opportunities in Hamburg (Kinderbetreuer/in)
jobs.description: At Native Nanny, we specialize in international childcare placements across Germany. We connect families with caring, qualified childcare professionals – and help nannies, babysitters, and tutors with international backgrounds find the right family match.We are currently looking for experienced nannies, babysitters, and tutors to work with families in Hamburg and the surrounding areas. If you speak English, French, Italian, or another widely spoken language, we’d love to hear from you!Your Responsibilities- Provide loving, attentive, and safe care for children.- Organize and structure daily routines with age-appropriate activities such as games, creative play, reading, or homework support.- Accompany children to and from school, nursery, or extracurricular activities.- Handle light, child-related housekeeping: meal prep, tidying play areas, laundry, etc.Your Profile- Experience with children or babies is essential. A background in education or childcare is a strong advantage.- You’re caring, empathetic, and genuinely enjoy working with children.- You’re reliable, organized, and flexible in your schedule.- You have a friendly, open, and professional attitude.- You speak English, French, Italian, or another common European language fluently.Why Join Us?- Bring your cultural diversity and language skills into a role where they make a difference.- Get matched with families that value your skills and background.- Be part of a trusted network of international childcare professionals.If you're passionate about childcare and want to make a difference in a family’s life, we’d love to hear from you!Apply now by submitting your CV directly on our website.We look forward to welcoming you to the Native Nanny community!

jobs.description: AEROSPACE DATA SECURITY GMBH Aerospace Data Security GmbH (ASDS) is an innovative technology company of the Airbus Group. For more than 25 years, we have been developing highly secure communication and cryptography solutions for customers in aerospace, defence, and other security-critical sectors .Around 80 employees from different nations and disciplines work together at our three locations in Stuhr near Bremen . the selection process in close cooperation with the relevant departments• Developing job profiles and recruitment strategies together with the departments• Identifying and directly approaching suitable candidates through various recruitment channels• Maintaining and further developing our recruitment activities while ensuring a positive candidate experienceHR Administration & HR Operations• Managing HR administration throughout the entire employee lifecycle, from onboarding to offboarding• Preparing employment contracts, certificates and references• Maintaining employee records and supporting payroll preparation in cooperation with our external payroll provider• Handling statutory reporting and certification procedures• Managing temporary agency workers and coordinating with staffing agencies• Preparing HR reports, statistics and evaluations• Supporting internal HR projects and contributing to the optimization and digitalization of HR processesWHAT WE OFFER• Flexible working arrangements and flexitime without core working hours• 30 days of annual leave (based on full-time employment)• Corporate fitness membership (choice of EGYM Wellpass or Hansefit)• Business bike leasing• Ongoing professional development opportunities• Flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes• A high level of personal responsibility and room for initiative• A collaborative working environment and great team eventsYOUR PROFIL What you bring to the table:• Completed commercial or business-related vocational training, ideally with a focus on Human Resources, or an equivalent qualification• Initial professional experience in recruiting and/or HR administration• Enjoyment of actively approaching and attracting new talent• Experience in candidate communication and the use of common recruitment channels• Confident and professional communication with candidates and managers• Knowledge of employment, social security or payroll tax regulations is an advantage• Confident use of MS Office; experience with HR software such as HR Works is a plus• Strong communication skills, a service-oriented mindset and an interest in working with people• Structured, independent and reliable way of working• Discretion and a strong sense of responsibility when handling confidential employee information• Good German language skills; English skills are an advantageINTERESTED?Does the position sound interesting, but you don't meet every single requirement or feel a bit unsure? jobs.occupation: Systemadministrator (m/w/d) Infrastruktur & IT-Sicherheit (IT-Systemadministrator/in)
jobs.description: Job DescriptionFor more than 30 years, Advancis has been developing innovative software solutions for security and building automation. As one of the international market leaders, our solutions are used worldwide in businesses, critical infrastructures, and complex building environments.As a System Administrator (m/f/d), you administer systems with a strong focus on security and take a holistic approach, from network design to selecting the right tools. IT security is an integral part of your mindset, including concepts such as Zero Trust, network segmentation, and SIEM. We are currently building our Information Security Management System (ISMS) and preparing for ISO/IEC 27001 certification. This means that systems are not only operated but are also assessed based on risk and documented in a transparent and traceable manner. Experience with ISO 27001 is an advantage but not a requirement. However, a willingness to think and work within this framework is essential.Why us?• Modern and attractive working environment• Open and dynamic company culture• Exciting tasks within a highly motivated team• Diverse career development opportunities, including support for professional and personal growth• Attractive compensation package with participation in the company's success• Flexible working hours• Company health insurance and retirement benefits• Benefits such as fitness programs, massage, yoga, JobRad bicycle leasing, or public transport ticket• Centrally located office with excellent public transport connections, as well as ample parking and EV charging facilities• Regular company eventsYour mission• Planning and implementation of IT projects, particularly in the areas of infrastructure and networking• Operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the existing IT environment• Ensuring IT security, including vulnerability and risk management (e.g., IAM, network segmentation, incident response)• Identifying and implementing automation opportunities within daily operations• Providing support in day-to-day IT operations (endpoint management, employee lifecycle processes, user support)• Technical consulting and support for business departments and international locationsYour profile• Several years of experience in IT systems administration and the implementation of IT projects• Very good knowledge of hybrid Microsoft 365 environments (Entra ID, Exchange Online, Office Suite)• Solid experience with Microsoft Windows Server and client systems, as well as hyperconverged virtualization platforms (Hyper-V)• Good knowledge of network architecture, modern networking technologies, storage solutions (on-premises and cloud), as well as backup and recovery management• Basic knowledge of VoIP PBX systems, Linux including Docker, and application administration• Independent, efficient, and structured way of working, combined with excellent communication skills• Understanding of risk-based decision-making, with the ability to balance and justify technical decisions against security requirements, operational feasibility, and cost-efficiency• Knowledge of information security management and initial exposure to ISO/IEC 27001, BSI IT-Grundschutz, or similar frameworks is desirable but not required• Ability to document complex technical matters in a clear and traceable way, from operational documentation to configuration and change records that stand up to audit requirements• Fluent German language skills (C1 level) and very good English language skills (B2 level)About usAt Advancis, people are at the heart of everything we do. Our success is built on the ideas, expertise and commitment of our employees. That's why we foster a work environment based on trust, teamwork and mutual respect.We provide the freedom to bring in new ideas, take ownership and grow both professionally and personally. Short decision-making processes, modern working conditions and an open company culture enable everyone to make a real impact.We value diversity and welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion, disability, age, sexual orientation or gender identity. We believe the best ideas emerge when different perspectives come together.One Advancis. Shaping the future together.

jobs.occupation: Expert SAP S/4HANA Cloud Environment Engineer (f/m/d) (Büroassistent/in)
jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Expert SAP S/4HANA Cloud Environment Engineer (f/m/d) to join our Business Services (https://jobs.pwc.de/de/de/interne-dienstleistungsbereiche)  division starting from March 2026.Your responsibilitiesResponsibility – As a part of the Product & Technology team, you will deploy and configure SAP BTP services. You will cooperate with business analysts, developers, and deployment teams to prevent and resolve technical issues, ensuring integration and optimization across platforms.Automation - You support the automation tools from SAP BTP (e.g. Build Process Automation) and drive continuous improvement with additional suitable tools. You implement security measures, ensure compliance, and engage stakeholders with clear, focused communication.Solutions – You define guidelines, standards, and manage infrastructure to deliver and maintain SAP S/4HANA-based processes and solutions, ensuring end-to-end integration and optimization within the cloud environment.Innovations – You assess emerging cloud technologies, evaluate SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud and SAP BTP innovations, and drive continuous improvement by leveraging tools for automation and efficiency.Your profile- You have completed your studies in computer science, economics, or a comparable field.- You bring several years of experience in SAP BTP management and SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud integrations.- You have in-depth knowledge of modern technologies such as cloud management platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible.- You have in-depth knowledge of modern technologies such as cloud management platforms, especially SAP Business Technology Platform- You have extensive experience in configuring and optimizing SAP BTP to SAP S/4HANA integrations.- You are fluent in English and German both spoken and written.- Your analytical, independent, and structured approach to work supports you defining guidelines. Furthermore, your communication enables effective collaboration with various teams.Your benefitsFlexibility – We encourage you to choose your working hours and your working place the way that suits you and your lifestyle. We do not have core working hours and we also offer you the possibility of home office or temporary work from abroad. Always in accordance with operational requirements and labor law regulations. Career Development – We are passionate about your personal and professional development, therefore we offer your regular training with our internal Academy, international experiences by doing a secondment and continuous mentoring on the job. Also, we support you on finding suitable external trainings and further education programmes. Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime on your annual working time account (JAZ) and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. Any remaining overtime is paid out once a year. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups and divers sport offerings. Take part in our free company sports programme or benefit from reduced rates at various gyms or an Urban Sports Club membership.And there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website.At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society. As part of our internal IT team (Products & Technology), you are the driver behind our promise: human-led and tech-powered. We are experts for our technology solutions and make the use of technology easier and more efficient. As a team, we develop innovative solutions for the entire product life cycle and manage the use of technology in the organization. Drive the technological development of PwC Germany in our diverse teams!ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Patricia Weiss at +49 69 9585-2222.

starting at the earliest possible opportunity.Your responsibilitiesStrategy – You translate executive business priorities into cloud, GenAI and Agentic AI transformation roadmaps and help clients compelling AWS and AI transformation narratives for C-level stakeholders, influence strategic decision-making, build trusted executive relationships and drive business-led transformation from strategy to execution.Your profile- You have successfully completed a degree in Business Administration, Economics, Technology Management, Computer Science, or a comparable field.- You bring 6-10 years of professional experience in strategy consulting, business transformation, and/or technology strategy, including the development of business cases, operating models and executive-level programs.- You possess deep AWS expertise combined with strong executive advisory capabilities and can translate complex business requirements across cloud, GenAI and Agentic AI into scalable solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.- You have a proven track record of acting as a trusted advisor to senior client executives, driving strategic initiatives from initial concept through implementation and orchestrating collaboration across business and technology teams.- You communicate confidently in English and German, combine a collaborative and hands-on approach with a strong enthusiasm for GenAI and emerging technologies to turn innovative ideas into tangible client value.Your benefitsFlexibility – In coordination with your team, you can expect a mix of working in the office and home office. In addition, you have the opportunity to work temporarily in over 40 countries.Family – Working parents bring huge value to our firm and we want to ensure that they are supported at every stage and feel confident balancing their work and home lives. We combine design thinking methods with collaborative workshop formats to involve as many stakeholders as possible from brainstorming to go-live. Help us to leverage the growth potential of our clients in the digital world!ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Felix Baumecker at +49 69 9585-2222.
